settings.heading: Recurring should never be a surprise.
settings.text: Dandy only enables a subscription when a genuine Shopify selling plan exists and its charge, renewal, cadence, shipping, and cancellation path can be shown together.

settings.heading: Explicit choice
settings.text: One-time remains the genuine fallback until a supported plan is connected and tested.

settings.heading: Charge beside the choice
settings.text: Show today's total, renewal amount, discount, shipping, and cadence before add to cart.

settings.heading: A real control path
settings.text: Edit, skip, pause, cancel, and support instructions must match the selected app and account flow.

settings.heading: Consent you can see.
settings.text: The current store has no selling plans, so the development buy box does not fabricate one.

settings.fallback_content:
Final subscription policy required

[FINAL POLICY + INTEGRATION REQUIRED: eligible products, discount, charge today, renewal amount and cadence, shipping, taxes, payment failures, inventory changes, edits, skips, pauses, cancellations, cutoff timing, refunds, notifications, account access, and support path.]

[FINAL TESTING REQUIRED: gateway eligibility, selling-plan IDs, cart behavior, initial order, renewal, failed payment, edit, cancel, and transactional messaging.]

settings.question: Am I enrolled automatically?
settings.answer: No. Subscription must be an explicit, available choice backed by a real Shopify selling plan.

settings.question: What will I be charged?
settings.answer: The live choice must show today's total and the real renewal amount and cadence. [FINAL TERMS REQUIRED: tax and shipping treatment.]

settings.question: How do I cancel or edit?
settings.answer: [FINAL APP + POLICY REQUIRED: exact portal, authentication, cutoff, edit/skip/pause/cancel steps, and support fallback.]

settings.question: What happens if an item is unavailable?
settings.answer: [FINAL OPERATIONS REQUIRED: inventory, substitution, delay, notification, charge, and cancellation rules.]

settings.heading: Every renewal deserves a clear answer.
settings.text: Final language must match the selected app, gateway, and tested customer workflow.
